verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a probe pointing to an official Microsoft MCP server on Microsoft Learn. That appears to be a documentation-level MCP server spanning Learn content, including Entra docs, rather than an Entra ID–specific server for agents to manage identities, apps or policies. It gives agents only thin, adjacent access to Entra knowledge. Missing for 10: an Entra/Graph-specific MCP server exposing tenant operations, documentation of tools, auth and setup for agent connection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
